summary: Make all pip requirements files ASCII-safe after the clean release archive reproduced a CP936 decode failure while installing optional browser dependencies.
decision_refs: User request to continue preparing the final version on 2026-10-10.
approval_evidence: The user asked to continue preparing the final version; the failure was reproduced only at the clean-package boundary and the correction is limited to dependency-file encoding plus its regression.
known_limitations: This change does not certify answer quality, Windows DPAPI behavior or customer database migration/restore.
A source ZIP is the current distribution artifact; no native Windows installer or code-signing certificate is introduced.
The old 200dee7 archive is invalidated and must not be published.
